test_cases.name: draft_from_folder
test_cases.input: Draft a Discussion section for the XTCs in F-XTC-109
assertions: Fetches XTCs in the named folder
Separates documentation deviations from system issues
Preserves GitHub and attachment hyperlinks as <a> tags
Presents the draft and waits for approval before any write

test_cases.name: insert_after_approval
test_cases.input: I approve replacing the Discussion field of DOC-47 with this text
assertions: Confirms hyperlinks are present after the PUT

test_cases.name: restore_lost_links
test_cases.input: The GitHub issues lost their hyperlinks. Redo the Discussion with clickable links
assertions: Re-fetches source XTC reviewer comments for original hrefs
Emits real <a href> tags for each GitHub issue and attachment
